# GetShortlisted

> GetShortlisted (getshortlisted.com) is an India-focused career service that optimizes job seekers' Naukri.com profiles and resumes so they appear in recruiter searches and get more recruiter calls. Founded by Nishit Salian. Independent service — not affiliated with Naukri.com or Info Edge (India) Ltd.

Key facts:
- Services: Naukri profile optimization (resume headline, key skills, profile summary, employment details, projects, desired career profile) and ATS-friendly resume optimization/writing.
- Who it is for: freshers and experienced professionals across India, IT and non-IT roles, people on notice period, after layoffs, career switchers and those with career gaps.
- How it works: candidate submits name, phone, email, Naukri profile link and/or resume link, experience and target role -> profile audit -> optimized profile + resume -> candidate updates profile -> recruiter calls typically start within about a week (not guaranteed).
- No Naukri password is required. No fake experience is added.
- Contact: hello@getshortlisted.com or the form at https://getshortlisted.com/contact/

## Services
- [Naukri Profile Optimization](https://getshortlisted.com/naukri-profile-optimization/): What is optimized in a Naukri profile and why keywords decide recruiter visibility.
- [Resume Optimization](https://getshortlisted.com/resume-optimization/): ATS-friendly, keyword-optimized resume writing for Indian job seekers.
